Manual applies use dev/prod, with environment protection." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="525" x="1705" y="240" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legend-3-badge" parent="1" style="fontFamily=Helvetica;html=1;rounded=1;fillColor=light-dark(#007CBD,#007CBD);fillStyle=auto;strokeColor=default;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontSize=22;fontStyle=1;" value="3" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="40" x="1650" y="360" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legend-3-text" parent="1" style="fontFamily=Helvetica;html=1;text;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=0;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontColor=light-dark(#172B3A,#F2F5F7);fontSize=15;fontStyle=0;" value="<b>Deploy in dependency order</b><br>The selected workspace plans the platform before monitoring. A manual apply creates EKS first. A missing cluster defers the read-only monitoring plan." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="525" x="1705" y="360" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legend-4-badge" parent="1" style="fontFamily=Helvetica;html=1;rounded=1;fillColor=light-dark(#007CBD,#007CBD);fillStyle=auto;strokeColor=default;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontSize=22;fontStyle=1;" value="4" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="40" x="1650" y="480" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legend-4-text" parent="1" style="fontFamily=Helvetica;html=1;text;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=0;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontColor=light-dark(#172B3A,#F2F5F7);fontSize=15;fontStyle=0;" value="<b>Keep states separate</b><br>Each workspace has separate platform and monitoring objects in a shared S3 bucket. Applies use native .tflock objects; read-only plans are unlocked." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="525" x="1705" y="480" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legend-5-badge" parent="1" style="fontFamily=Helvetica;html=1;rounded=1;fillColor=light-dark(#007CBD,#007CBD);fillStyle=auto;strokeColor=default;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontSize=22;fontStyle=1;" value="5" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="40" x="1650" y="600" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legend-5-text" parent="1" style="fontFamily=Helvetica;html=1;text;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=0;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontColor=light-dark(#172B3A,#F2F5F7);fontSize=15;fontStyle=0;" value="<b>Connect after EKS exists</b><br>The monitoring root discovers EKS through AWS and authenticates with aws eks get-token. Raw plan values are not published.<br><br><b>Cleanup reverses the order</b><br>Destroy monitoring while controllers can remove the ALB and volumes, then destroy the platform and run the AWS audit.<br><br><b>Scope</b><br>IAM apply roles are privileged. div.div:
Plan feedback
One PR comment per environment is updated with counts, status, commit and workflow link. Raw plan values are not published.
Cleanup reverses the order
Destroy monitoring while controllers can remove the ALB and volumes, then destroy the platform and run the AWS audit.
Scope
IAM apply roles are privileged. Workspaces separate state; they do not isolate AWS accounts.
